notes: SecondQuest Production Standard. English is the production and default output language; Spanish (and any other locale) is optional and only produced/rendered on explicit request (--locale <code>). New episodes are scaffolded from these values.

render.policy: Renders use defaultLocale unless --locale is passed explicitly. Non-default locales are never rendered as part of the normal flow.

es.name: SecondQuest Spanish Voice v1
es.note: Native Kokoro embedding blend: 40% am_michael + 60% em_alex (weighted sum of the style tensors). Spanish is an optional locale, produced/rendered only on explicit request (--locale es).

audio.policy: No continuous music bed by default. Narration > SFX > Ambience > Silence. Music cues are allowed only when an episode sets music.producerApproved = true (explicit Producer request).

art.policy: Every image a render uses must be source=FINAL_ART (delivered by the Creative Pipeline) or source=PROCEDURAL (made by the engine's own free tools, e.g. tools/props3d, with a `generator` that rebuilds it), status=APPROVED. Missing/invalid art blocks the render (ASSET_MISSING, NOT_FINAL_ART, BAD_RESOLUTION, SAFE_ZOOM, SWAP_MISMATCH, QUEST_VERSION_MISMATCH). Renders are capped at maxOutput (1080p); backgrounds must be at least maxOutput x safeZoomDefaults.background (2304x1296), 4K is welcome but not required; a background may be zoomed up to its own resolution / maxOutput (never upscaled). The engine never crops, upscales or substitutes generated art.
